title: Human Rights Watch Report Raises Alarm on Civilian Casualties From Pakistani Strikes
detail: Human Rights Watch published 'Pakistani Strikes in Afghanistan Raise Civilian Casualty Concerns' on July 15, 2026, recapping the June 28-29 strikes on Chamkani, Gyan, and Marawara (UNAMA: 28 killed, 49 injured) alongside earlier 2026 strikes, and reiterating that international humanitarian law requires distinction and proportionality regardless of violations by the opposing side.

sources.name: Human Rights Watch — Pakistani Strikes in Afghanistan Raise Civilian Casualty Concerns

media.caption: HRW raised alarm over civilian casualties from Pakistan's 2026 cross-border strikes, including the June 28-29 episode.
